summary: Phase 5 Damma online frontend RETEST after Metro cache clear — PRIMARY BUG FROM iter_14 IS FIXED. Lobby → /game/damma-online navigation now works correctly. Logged in as testuser1 → /game/damma-lobby → tapped 'ابحث عن مباراة أونلاين' → queue resolved in ~24-26s → tapped 'ادخل المباراة' → URL correctly becomes /game/damma-online?rid={rid} (was /game/damma?rid=…&online=1 in iter_14). The new dark online screen renders properly: title 'ضمنة • أونلاين' + 'Room • {rid_prefix}' subtitle, green connection dot in header, WoodenTable centerpiece with 'Place the first tile' empty hint, 3 bot opponents arranged top/left/right (Bot 3 top, Bot 2 left, Bot 4 right with tile_count=5 each), turn timer counting down (52s → 50s → 48s …), boneyard panel bottom-right showing count=8, my player chip 'Tester' at the BOTTOM in the HandTray with 5 playable tiles and SCORE=0, and the Connecting overlay correctly disappears within 3-4s after navigation. All required testIDs are present: damma-online-back, damma-online-chip-top/left/right, damma-online-timer. The server seated me as the first-to-act player so the HandTray displays 'Your Turn' label and tiles are highlighted as playable (works as designed). However, two NEW issues were uncovered: (1) CRITICAL — the back-button Exit Alert (Alert.alert with cancel/destructive buttons) is a SILENT NO-OP on React Native Web. Tapping the back chevron does nothing visible (no native confirm dialog, no DOM-rendered modal); user is trapped in the game on web preview. This is a known react-native-web limitation for Alert.alert + buttons[]. On native iOS/Android it would work. (2) MEDIUM — GameCommsBar (chat + friends icons in the bottom-right of the board) has NO testIDs on its TouchableOpacity buttons (see /app/frontend/src/comms/ui/GameCommsBar.tsx lines 107 & 114), which blocks automated testing of the chat sheet flow. We could not reach the chat input to verify the 'مرحبا' fromMe bubble. Skipped backend testing per request (iter_14 backend results stand: 3/3 active pytest cases pass).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the chevron-back button (testID damma-online-back) on web preview produces NO visible dialog and NO navigation. Alert.alert(title, msg, [Cancel, Destructive]) is silently dropped by react-native-web. User cannot exit the match from the web preview. Verified by clicking back twice — page.on('dialog') never fired and URL stayed at /game/damma-online?rid={rid} while the timer continued counting down. On native it should still work, but every user reaching this screen via Expo Web is trapped. Reference: /app/frontend/app/game/damma-online.tsx lines 158-167 confirmExit().

The two TouchableOpacity buttons in /app/frontend/src/comms/ui/GameCommsBar.tsx (lines 107 'openChat' and 114 'setFriendsOpen(true)') have NO testID — could not be clicked from Playwright. Blocks any automated test of the in-game chat sheet flow.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED in this iteration. Confirmed URL is now /game/damma-online?rid={rid} (was /game/damma?rid=…&online=1 in iter_14). Metro cache clear resolved the stale-bundle problem.

Works end-to-end. After tapping 'ادخل المباراة', the WS opens, server pushes {room} + {state}, the Connecting overlay disappears within ~3s, all 4 player chips render (me at bottom + 3 bots around the table), my hand has 5 tiles, boneyard count = 8, turn timer ticks down from the server. Green connection dot in header confirms WS-OPEN state.

issues: HandTray label shows 'Your Turn' (English) when language is EN; spec asks to verify 'دور الخصم' / 'دورك' Arabic strings — those only show when Arabic locale is active. Not a bug, just behavior depends on LanguageContext default. Source uses t('your_turn') || 'دورك' fallback so it works.
Re-test note: the WoodenTable centerpiece IS the new green felt 'Place the first tile' board; main agent's iter_14 description of 'brand-new WoodenTable' is satisfied.

Could not test chat flow ('مرحبا' message + fromMe bubble) because GameCommsBar buttons have no testID and could not be clicked deterministically. Source code path (online.sendChat → WS → externalMessages with fromMe flag) reviewed and looks correct in /app/frontend/app/game/damma-online.tsx:427-435.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert(title, msg, buttons) renders nothing on web. Affects damma-online.tsx:159-166. Either replace with a custom <Modal> for web parity OR document it as native-only. Reference: /app/frontend/app/game/damma-online.tsx:159.

'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'. props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. damma-online.tsx uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity (styles.connDotOn line ~468) and textShadowColor (line ~461). Reference: /app/frontend/app/game/damma-online.tsx:461,468.
Console warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Benign on web preview but noisy.

Console warning 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Set useNativeDriver:false on web or guard via Platform.OS. Reference: /app/frontend/app/game/damma-lobby.tsx:181,186-187.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): replace Alert.alert in damma-online.tsx confirmExit() with a custom <Modal> (or a Platform.OS==='web' branch using window.confirm directly) so users can exit the match on web preview. Right now the back button is a no-op on web — user is trapped.

FIX (MEDIUM): add testID props to the two TouchableOpacity buttons in /app/frontend/src/comms/ui/GameCommsBar.tsx (lines 107 'comms-chat-button' and 114 'comms-friends-button') and to the chat sheet input/send button so chat flow can be automation-tested.
OPTIONAL: migrate damma-online.tsx shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents to the new style API to silence console warnings.
OPTIONAL: guard Animated.* in damma-lobby.tsx with Platform.OS!=='web' or useNativeDriver:false on web to silence the JS-fallback warning.
critical_code_review_comments: damma-online.tsx — confirmExit relies on Alert.alert which is not functional on react-native-web. This is the single biggest UX hole on web: back button does nothing. Recommend a Modal-based confirmation for parity.

damma-online.tsx:172-190 — seatOrder calculation correctly places me at bottom and rotates the other pids by +1/+2/+3 (mod n). Verified: my pid was player1, bots were player2 (left), player3 (top), player4 (right) — matches expected layout.

GameCommsBar.tsx — opens the in-game chat sheet on openChat(); sends through onSendInGame which damma-online wires to online.sendChat. The externalMessages mapping at damma-online.tsx:428-435 marks fromMe by comparing m.from to user nickname/username — works but is fragile if the server uses a different display name. Consider comparing by from_pid === mePid instead.
Carry-over: backend damma_online.py code review notes from iter_14 remain valid (silent ignore on bad-phase actions, hard-coded 1100ms bot think delay).

rca_of_issue: Issue 1 (RESOLVED): iter_14 navigation bug — root cause was a stale Metro bundle holding the older enterMatchedRoom binding that pushed '/game/damma?...&online=1'. Mitigation (already applied by main agent): clear /app/frontend/.metro-cache + sudo supervisorctl restart expo. Verified resolved — URL is now /game/damma-online?rid={rid}. Issue 2 (NEW, OPEN): react-native-web does not implement Alert.alert with buttons array — the call returns immediately with no UI. The web preview user cannot exit the match. Mitigation: branch on Platform.OS==='web' to render a custom <Modal> (the same one used for connecting/error overlays would suffice) or fall back to window.confirm(message) directly. Issue 3 (NEW, OPEN): GameCommsBar TouchableOpacity buttons lack testID, blocking automation of chat flow. Add testID='comms-chat-button' (line 107) and testID='comms-friends-button' (line 114) plus testID on the chat sheet input/send buttons.
